name: KDTree-based Neighbor Counting
aliases: Per-Voxel Point Density Calculation via KDTree
definition: Calculates the density of mesh vertices within each voxel by querying neighboring points using a KDTree and normalizing counts.
summary: KDTree-based Neighbor Counting calculates normalized point density per voxel by querying neighbors via a KDTree, differing from KDE by using discrete counts rather than smoothing.
